reviews.text: This app was great once. They updated it with AI and it lost every single one of its previous benefits. We don't need AI for a card reader. All I need is functionality

Good could be great
reviews.text:
Updated my review: good to bad now!! 
Older review: Good could be great if advertised feature actually worked completely. I have the latest iOS and CamCard revision. Most cards required editing information even with the enhanced AI “smart” feature enabled. Also, contacts do not automatically go into your designated contacts. Other UX issues but above are my biggest concern. This could really be an awesome business card app.

reviews.title: Changed its Policy
reviews.text: Bought app 10 years ago, now forces ne to buy it again

reviews.title: Years of contacts deleted
reviews.text: I’ve used this for many years, thought it was a cool app: admittedly haven’t opened it in a few months but stuff has always been there. They added a new paid subscription and deleted all my info without notice. 0/10 would not recommend to anyone after this

reviews.title: Another attempted theft?
reviews.text: Terrible. Awful. The product that I paid for, I can no longer access. Doom on the developers whom instead of creating a different app that they could charge for at will, replaced the fully functional app that many of us paid for. This is extortion. SaaS is a failure.  Write good software and charge a fair price for a license to use it.  Beyond that, I do not have a relationship with you and I do not want a relationship with you.  One thing is for sure. No one should continue a relationship with you.  So long CamCard.  You will not be missed.

reviews.title: Uses live activities to show ads
reviews.text: Leaving a review because this app had the audacity to put a live activity on my lock screen and show me an ad for their premium features.  Absolutely not.

reviews.title: Bad card now
reviews.text: I had this CamCard since it came out. It was great over the past few years. It has become terrible and when I downloaded the new app, it was too difficult to use. Also, I do not want to pay a yearly fee. I have to find another business card holder.

reviews.title: SCAM ALERT
reviews.text:
Steer well clear. Have used this app for a while, and it’s been getting significantly worse compared to competitors (lots of errors in text scanning requiring manual correction). So I signed up for premium to allow me to export my data and use someone else - I was going to sign up for a month for £10 but was then offered a “free trial” for three days. On taking this free trial, I was immediately charged £50 for a full year subscription. When I complained, the developer said the free trial was only for new users, but nowhere was this shown to me at the time of purchase. They are now refusing to refund, saying only Apple can do that. So I’ve been scammed out of £40.

So I would highly recommend using an alternate service that works better and won’t try and scam you.
